name: Diagfield
description: Two inks: a solid one behind, and a wedge over it that grows along the diagonal.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: var(--color1); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(0% 0%, @calc(4 + 96 * (@x + @y) / (@X + @Y))% 0%, 0% @calc(4 + 96 * (@x + @y) / (@X + @Y))%); clip-path: polygon(0% 0%, @calc(4 + 96 * (@x + @y) / (@X + @Y))% 0%, 0% @calc(4 + 96 * (@x + @y) / (@X + @Y))%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
